name: Arcane Bolt (TEST)
note: test.fixture-migration: the invented Arcane Bolt (2026-08-14) — the engine's first power, the cooldown and primary-action tests' instrument. The test cohort's Air Mage casts it. fix.one-effect-vocabulary (2026-10-01): an effects list (statDamage) like every power; the legacy stat/bonus/damageType fields are retired.

name: Second Wind (TEST)
note: refactor.one-action-type (2026-09-04): a POWER carrying a movement rider (gainStamina — Focus's rider) — 'all of them should be capable of doing all of the same things' (Angela 2026-09-04). Free, cooldown 1: the cooldown means one thing on every action now (skip N Turns).

name: Two packets (TEST)
note: fix.ordered-power-preview: two packets share and consume one protection pool. Test data only.

name: Strip then strike (TEST)
note: fix.ordered-power-preview: the second pure-data variant removes protection before damage.

name: Early guard (TEST)
note: A power uses movement and leaves primary open.

name: Free recovery (TEST)
note: Unlimited core readiness; AI deliberately chooses a free action once per cycle.

name: Twin Flame (TEST)
note: rule.bursts: ordered independent source packets share one low-cover budget and Protection pool; hex targeting, no attack hooks.

name: Mercy Ring (TEST)
note: rule.bursts: healing-only burst is blocked by high props but not attenuated by low props; no onBurst damage reaction.

name: Lantern (TEST)
note: capability.stealth (engine, 2026-09-28): the reveal effect kind on a TEST power - every enemy within 3 hexes of the caster has any status that breaks on a reveal broken, and nobody further. The radius is the power's own area targeting (the one targeting vocabulary). The Codex reveal powers (Flush Them Out, Spectral Sight, Second Sight, Raise the Torch, Flare, Brilliant Torch, Scouting) compile to this kind later. No campaign claim.

name: Fend (TEST)
note: engine capability.counterattack-and-fend (2026-10-04): Fend, the second special free attack a power puts up — the same statMod shape as the Longsword's Counterattack with the other stat, pure data. The numbers are the ruled trinket's (engine DECISIONS.md 2026-09-28 'two new trinkets': free use, 1 Stamina, cooldown 7, Fend until the end of your next turn); the trinket itself has no Codex row yet. Test data only.

name: Swell (TEST)
note: engine capability.raise-lower-magic (2026-10-05): a test row that RAISES a side's party stat for a number of Turns - the Magic of the caster's own side by 2, this Turn and the next - so the mechanism is held on a raise and on a Turn count as well as on the Vortex's battle-long lowering. No unit row grants it: a test hands it to a unit.

name: Field Dressing (TEST)
note: engine capability.stabilise-downed-ally (2026-10-05): a second power that stops a downed ally's bleed-out count, with other numbers than the Bandages' - within 2 hexes, 1 Stamina, a cooldown and no limit of uses - so the mechanism is held on a second row, pure data. Fielded only by test.field-dressing.

name: Snare (TEST)
note: engine rule.computer-avoids-own-traps (2026-10-06): a trap an ENEMY places (no enemy row of the Codex places one) - one trap on an empty hex within 3, 2 physical damage and 1 Root - so the rule is held for the enemy's side as well as the heroes'. Fielded only by test.snarer-traps.
